en.headline: HKU study finds chronic disease scheme improves health indicators
en.dek: Nearly 6,000 participants with newly diagnosed diabetes, hypertension or prediabetes showed significant gains after one year of follow-up under the government pilot.
body: A University of Hong Kong study released on Monday found that participants in the Chronic Disease Co-care Pilot Scheme recorded clear improvements in key health indicators after one year of multidisciplinary management.

The Faculty of Medicine, commissioned by the Health Bureau, analysed data from nearly 6,000 people newly diagnosed with diabetes, hypertension or prediabetes who completed a year of follow-up. Among diabetes participants, average glycated haemoglobin fell from 7.76 per cent to 6.70 per cent. Hypertension participants saw notable drops in systolic blood pressure and bad cholesterol. Those with prediabetes improved on body-mass index and cholesterol measures.

Matched analysis showed diabetes participants were 2.8 times more likely to achieve blood-sugar targets than comparable people who did not join the scheme. Hypertension and prediabetes participants also had higher rates of reaching blood-pressure and weight targets. Researchers estimated that, scaled to the more than 200,000 people who have joined, the scheme could reduce stroke and heart-failure cases by about 9 per cent and peripheral vascular disease by 10 per cent over the next decade.

More than 90 per cent of surveyed participants said their ability to manage their health had improved, and over 96 per cent found the district health centre services helpful. A Primary Healthcare Commission consultant described the first-year results as encouraging for a prevention-focused, community-based model.

zh.headline: 港大研究：慢病共治計劃一年後健康指標顯著改善
zh.dek: 近6000名新確診糖尿病、高血壓或前期糖尿病參加者完成一年跟進後，血糖血壓等指標明顯改善。
body: 港大醫學院周一公佈研究結果，顯示參與「慢性疾病共同治理先導計劃」的新確診病人，在接受一年跨專業健康管理後，各項關鍵健康指標均有顯著改善。
醫學院獲醫務衛生局委託進行評估，分析近6000名完成一年跟進的新確診糖尿病、高血壓或前期糖尿病參加者數據。糖尿病參加者的平均糖化血紅蛋白由7.76%下降至6.70%；高血壓參加者的上壓及壞膽固醇亦明顯下降；前期糖尿病參加者的體重指數及膽固醇水平有所改善。
配對分析顯示，糖尿病參加者血糖達標機會較未參與計劃的對照組高出2.8倍；高血壓及前期糖尿病參加者的血壓與體重達標率同樣較高。研究團隊以超過20萬名參加者推算，未來十年可減少約一成中風及心臟衰竭個案，以及一成周邊血管疾病個案。
逾九成受訪者表示管理健康能力有所提升，超過96%認同地區康健中心服務有幫助。基層醫療署顧問醫生形容首年結果令人鼓舞，顯示以預防為重、社區為本的模式有助及早介入。
